title: StatPrompt-LLM: A Lightweight Statistical Refinement for Foundation-Style Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.12974v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-series forecasting has recently seen a paradigm shift with the introduction of foundation-style models that adapt large pretrained language architectures to sequential data. However, effectively exposing fundamental temporal structures, such as trend, scale, and temporal dependence, to these models remains an open challenge, particularly when the available observations are limited. In this paper, we conduct an exploratory empirical study across different generations of forecasting architectures and propose StatPrompt-LLM, a lightweight statistical refinement of Time-LLM. StatPrompt-LLM augments the existing Time-LLM prompting mechanism with dataset-level statistical information and introduces a zero-initialised autoregressive bypass as a complementary linear forecasting pathway. translated_title: StatPrompt-LLM：一种面向基础模型风格时间序列预测的轻量级统计增强方法
translated_abstract: 随着将大型预训练语言架构适配到序列数据上的基础模型风格方法的出现，时间序列预测近期经历了一次范式转变。然而，如何有效地向这些模型呈现基本的时序结构——例如趋势、尺度和时间依赖性——仍然是一个尚未解决的挑战，尤其是在可用观测数据有限的情况下。在本文中，我们对不同代际的预测架构开展了一项探索性实证研究，并提出了 StatPrompt-LLM，即对 Time-LLM 的一种轻量级统计增强。StatPrompt-LLM 通过数据集级别的统计信息增强了现有的 Time-LLM 提示机制，并引入了一个零初始化的自回归旁路，作为补充性的线性预测通路。我们在电力和气象时间序列基准数据集（包括 ETTh1、ETTh2 和 Weather）上，于全前缀和缩减前缀两种设置下对所提出的框架进行了评估。
tldr: 提出 StatPrompt-LLM，通过在 Time-LLM 的提示中融入数据集级统计信息并增加一个零初始化自回归线性旁路，以轻量级方式增强基础模型风格的时间序列预测能力。
en_tdlr: StatPrompt-LLM refines Time-LLM in a lightweight manner by augmenting its prompting with dataset-level statistics and adding a zero-initialised autoregressive linear bypass, improving foundation-style time-series forecasting.
